Body.Content:
When you enable the Enable Handling of Multiple Eliminations in Investment Projects setting, you activate this feature.

Multiple eliminations: The system lets you configure project groups to allow you to eliminate the investment project multiple times when required. It helps acquire multiple assets for an investment project.

Financial impact: When an investment project is planned for further eliminations, the system records all associated costs as work in progress (WIP). This approach ensures that costs are not prematurely capitalized or expensed to maintain accurate financial reporting until all eliminations and asset acquisitions are finalized. By holding costs in WIP, the system supports compliance with accounting standards and prevents misstatement of asset values during the consolidation process.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/prod-pma/multiple-eliminations-investment-project

GA date: August CY2027

Preview date: September CY2026
